entities.title: Example tests
entities.summary: The library's examples, written as unit tests: UtvFirst/ shows each task with UTV and compares it with .NET; NativeFirst/ shows what .NET does and compares it with UTV.
entities.purpose: Shows how the library is used, in tests that run with dotnet test and so cannot drift from what the library does. They cover the scenario catalog of docs/example-tests.md, follow AGENTS.md section 1, and UTV-first tests marked BEGIN/END feed docs/side-by-side.md. Fixtures.DemoZoneRules gives every UTV zone test the pinned rules of conformance/rules/demo-zones.json, which the project links next to the test assembly.
boundaries: UTV zone operations never read the host's tz database; native-first zone tests (TimeZoneInfo) necessarily do, and need one that knows New York's and Paris's 2026–2027 rules.
Two native-first tests read the clock on purpose (DateTimeOffset.UtcNow, DateTime.Now), and say in their remarks why the outcome cannot depend on it.
